message: The other day, I found myself rummaging through our go-bags while the kids were busy with their screens. I stumbled upon some old board games tucked away in the corner. It hit me—preparing for emergencies doesn't just mean stocking up on supplies; it can also be about rediscovering low-tech fun with the family! We ended up spending hours playing, laughing, and just enjoying each other's company. Sometimes the simplest things are the best reminders of what really matters. What's your favorite way to keep things light and fun while staying ready?
